business_summary: Zhuhai Huajin Capital Co., Ltd. engages in the investment and management, electronic device manufacturing, water purification, and science and technology parks businesses in China and internationally. It offers investment management, equity investment, private equity fund management, asset management, venture capital investment, venture capital consulting services, and startup management services; and construction, operation, management, and consulting of water purification plants and related environmental protection project development. The company is also involved in the research, development, production, and sales of various liquid, chip, and solid aluminum electrolytic capacitors; lithium-ion battery production equipment; plug-in aluminum electrolytic capacitors, and chip electrolytic capacitor production equipment. In addition, it engages in technology company incubation, investment and asset management, technology services, property management, and industrial park construction and operation; real estate development, operation and management of digital information industrial parks and supporting services, public facilities management, infrastructure construction, investment in domestic and foreign high-tech enterprises, rental and property management, talent training and services, socio-economic consulting, enterprise management services, technology promotion services, and science and technology intermediary services; and construction and technology development of mobile TV networks, R&D, technology integration and product sales of mobile multimedia, and advertising business. Further, the company produces and sells crystal oscillators, sensors, and human health testing instruments, as well as business management and information consulting services. The company was formerly known as Leaguer Stock Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Zhuhai Huajin Capital Co., Ltd. in April 2017. Zhuhai Huajin Capital Co., Ltd. was founded in 1992 and is based in Zhuhai, China.
